summary: Enable the assistant by adding spec.lightspeed.disabled: false and chatbot_config_secret_name to the AAP CR; it takes a few minutes, and <cr>-lightspeed-api and <cr>-lightspeed-chatbot-api pods should be Running.
questions: How do I enable Lightspeed in the AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR?
How do I verify the intelligent assistant is running?

answer_card.title: Enable the intelligent assistant
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  lightspeed:
    disabled: false
    chatbot_config_secret_name: <your chatbot secret>
```
Save, wait a few minutes, then check Workloads > Pods for `myaap-lightspeed-api-*` and `myaap-lightspeed-chatbot-api-*` in *Running*.
